analysis:
Examined the supplied base text (lines 1045-1694) and head text (lines 1-551) of ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift, plus the bounded patch excerpt. Changed behavior visible in the excerpt: (1) head lines 396-397 add `addonHoldLoadRefusal(for:)` immediately before `isLoadingAny = true`, with the comment saying no suspension separates the fence from taking the load gate. (2) Head lines 576-577 re-check the add-on hold after hashing and before the pending-load recheck and shard allocation. (3) Around head 711-714, `isShuttingDown || Task.isCancelled` becomes `modelLoadInterruption(modelId)`, which throws its returned error instead of a plain CancellationError. Around head 942-948 and 1041-1048 there are further changes. They are only partly visible: the patch excerpt is truncated, and the head text stops at line 551.

These changes tighten admission. They align with TB-012, A-018 and T-059 (add-on hold socket and leases). A hold now stops new loads from starting and stops in-flight loads before weights are allocated, so models do not load beside running VMs. The throw sites release the newcomer and clear caches before throwing. The path at head 396-397 throws before `isLoadingAny` is set, so the load gate cannot leak. In the existing slot-cap error paths, `isLoadingAny` is reset before throwing.

No regression is identified in the visible code. The security-relevant items I could not verify are:
- The implementations of `addonHoldLoadRefusal` and `modelLoadInterruption`, which are outside the supplied evidence. This includes how they interact with the `loadErrorStatusCode` mapping: an error message that does not contain "slot" would map to 500 and could count as a provider fault.
- The cleanup performed on the new early-throw paths. After head 438, `modelsLoading` and `pendingLoad` are handled by the catch block, which is not visible here.
- The patch hunks at head 942-945 and 1041-1048, which are truncated. Integration should confirm that the revised startup-stop and shutdown paths still call `modelsLoading.remove`, release waiters and release the pending-load lease.

No changes touch T-041 cache storage, encryption, attestation or coordinator-facing data paths in the visible ranges.
